name: VaultSparkStudios.github.io
currentFocus: S344 closed a latent unattended-publish path into the public Desk: every downstream guard in news-publish.yml passed when its upstream step was SKIPPED (GitHub coerces an empty output and '0' to the same number), so a slot that drafted nothing ran the art renderer, the full Desk rebuild, the editorial gates and the public-feed cascade — held back from committing only by an ENOENT crash and the cadence gate, either of which a maintainer would have "fixed". Also ended a live homepage voice leak: the changelog's chore filter was dead code and 13 of 24 public sentences came from routine bookkeeping changes. Next: the founder clears the newsletter deploy permission, and picks the Desk cadence lever.
publicNote: The studio's news publisher could run its publishing steps even when the step before them had been skipped, because a skipped step reports nothing and the check treated nothing as success. Nothing incorrect was ever published — two unrelated faults happened to stop it in time, and either one looked like a small bug worth tidying up, which would have removed the protection. The check now tests for a value that cannot be mistaken for silence, and a new automated rule stops the pattern returning anywhere in the project. Separately, the short "what changed" line shown to returning visitors was carrying notes about our own build system rather than anything they could see; it now only mentions work that touched something on the site.
nextMilestone: The member newsletter sends for the first time — the function deployed, the shared secret set on both sides, and a founder-observed dispatch confirming delivery.
blockers: [ENG/P0] The Monthly Member Newsletter has never sent. Both faults are proven (function not deployed; NEWSLETTER_SECRET absent from Actions) and the repair is written and self-tested in scripts/deploy-member-newsletter.mjs. Execution was refused by the sandbox permission classifier — a permissions gap, not a missing credential. The function has no dry-run, so the first real send must be a founder-observed workflow_dispatch.

[DESK/P1] The Desk has published nothing since 2026-09-04 and public cadence has degraded to periodic. Measured: radar queues 4 topics against 211 rejected, while 4 slots/day against a 14-day novelty window needs ~56 stories. Escalated rather than retuned — cadence and novelty are a published promise (D-S344.5).
[QA/P0] The Phase 0 gate is a human walkthrough and has still not been run.

[SEC/P0] The gateway Supabase service-role slot remains scoped to a different project (ckwtolofoqzrqouqkmvs vs this site fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp) while check-secrets reports READY 2/2. Fix belongs in studio-ops via the S344 Ark cargo (CANON-018).
[AUTH/P0] The Obelisk provider journey remains unobserved. Use --watch, not --live.
